props.title: What it is, who it is for, what you need

items.description: A free, open-source website template for Astro and Tailwind: pages, widgets, a blog, SEO and image optimisation, ready to customise.
Developers, studios and small teams who want a fast, well-structured site without designing every section from scratch.
Node.js 22.22 or newer, an editor and about ten minutes. No account, no licence key.

props.note: If you need someone to edit the site with no developer nearby, a builder is genuinely the better answer. Saying so is what makes the other four rows believable.

items.title: How much detail is too much on a product page?
items.description: None, if it is organised by depth. Keep the first two screens skimmable and let the specifications carry the detail. Nobody leaves because a spec table is long; they leave because the first screen was vague.

items.title: Where do price and availability go?
items.description: Near the top for a known product, after the features for a new one. Either way on the page itself — “contact us for pricing” is a form in disguise and costs conversions.

items.title: What images does a product page need?
items.description: At least one of the product in use, not only on white. Screenshots for software, context shots for physical goods, a short clip if it moves. Office photography is not product photography.

items.title: Can I use it for client work?
items.description: Yes — MIT, no attribution required, unlimited sites. Studios shipping it under their own brand is the most common use.
